review_NumClassCheckHook: review the NumClassCheckHook class that validates num_classes consistency between model heads and dataset metainfo
use_NumClassCheckHook_before_train_epoch: use the before_train_epoch method to check training dataset class compatibility with model heads before each epoch
use_NumClassCheckHook_before_val_epoch: use the before_val_epoch method to check validation dataset class compatibility with model heads before each epoch
call_NumClassCheckHook_check_head: call the _check_head method to verify num_classes matches dataset classes length for a given mode
register_NumClassCheckHook_in_hooks: register the NumClassCheckHook in the HOOKS registry to automatically validate class counts during training and validation
